fields.summary_ko.0: CrowdStrike (CRWD) rose +8.2% on October 23 while the S&P 500 fell -0.5%, with other cybersecurity stocks like Palo Alto Networks also rising together.
fields.summary_ko.1: The rise was driven by reports from Evercore ISI's channel partner survey showing strengthened sector-wide budget outlook and CEO's forward guidance on increased breaches related to PHP vulnerabilities.
fields.summary_ko.2: Up +106.0% over the past 12 months, significantly exceeding the S&P 500's +15.1%, with price-to-sales of 48.7x, much higher than the S&P 500's 3.2x.
